answer.book: Hoornbeeck's 1651 Examen of a papal bull is one work: title page, quoted Osnabrück treaty article, dedication to the Utrecht senate, preface, the bull's printed text, then a theological disputation (Disputatio I and II) that answers it in numbered sections, followed by addenda and errata.
